title: Anthropic's Safety Superpower
summary: This Stratechery article analyzes how Anthropic's deep focus on AI safety has evolved from a philosophical stance into a competitive business advantage, particularly as enterprises and regulators increasingly prioritize trust and safety in AI systems.
problem_solved: Explores how Anthropic differentiates itself in the crowded AI market by making safety a core business strategy rather than just a technical constraint.
why_valuable: Reveals the strategic business case for AI safety investment, showing how safety concerns can drive enterprise adoption and regulatory trust.
